prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Pasadena, Texas, and has neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1073; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my name on a recording, but you can use the claim reference.
Q: Understood. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was stopped at a red light on a main road in Pasadena, Texas, in the right lane.
Q: What happened next?
A: The car behind me didn't stop in time. I felt a hard jolt from behind and my head snapped forward and back.
Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?
A: Yes, I was.
Q: Did you get out of your vehicle at the scene?
A: I got out, but I was dizzy and my neck was already sore. The other driver said they were sorry and that they'd looked down at their phone.
Q: Did you seek medical attention?
A: I went to an urgent care clinic later that afternoon. They diagnosed me with a neck strain and gave me a muscle relaxant and a referral to a physical therapist.
Q: How are you feeling now?
A: I still have stiffness in the neck, especially when I turn my head to check my blind spot. Sleeping has been harder, and I've missed a couple of days of work.
Q: Have you had any prior neck or back problems?
A: No, not that I can recall. I've been generally healthy.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?
A: Only that my car has visible damage to the rear bumper, and I'd like the claim handled as quickly as possible.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
A: Thank you.
